rationale: Price is trading below the session VWAP ($21.08) and below the 9-EMA ($20.64), sitting at only 38% of today's range after pulling back from the $21.95 high — momentum has faded and the last candle closed at the low of the sequence. The spread and mid-session positioning offer no clean directional edge: a long faces overhead supply from the VWAP and prior high, while a short risks a squeeze given the strong gap-up context and broad market strength (SPY +4.83%, VIXY -13%).
